name: How do I know if my roof needs to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my roof needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs your roof needs replacement include missing or cracked shingles, visible sagging, water stains on ceilings, or granule loss from asphalt shingles. You might also notice a sudden increase in your energy bills. A professional inspection can accurately assess your roof's condition and determine if a full replacement is necessary or if repairs are sufficient.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for missing or cracked shingles, sagging, water stains, or granule loss. A professional inspection is recommended to confirm if replacement is needed.
